confirm_with: Owner of GraphState / BuyerProfile (citizenship, household_type, first_timer values)
Owner of the SQLite resale tool (flat_type and town db_form values)
notes: Canonical values are what chunks (eligibility_tags) and topic cards (trigger_conditions) use.
The data.gov.sg HDB resale dataset uses uppercase forms such as '4 ROOM' and 'TAMPINES'. Use the db_form mapping below when building SQL filters; never put display forms into SQL.
db_form values are drafted from the public dataset's conventions and are NOT yet verified against the team's SQLite import. Confirm with the SQL tool owner before relying on them.
Citizenship codes follow the abbreviations used on hdb.gov.sg ('SC/ SC', 'SC/ SPR', 'SPR household', 'non-resident spouse'). They describe the HOUSEHOLD (applicant/co-applicant pair), not one person.
No captured page states rules for foreigners buying on their own. 'foreigner_only' exists so the advisor can route such users to an explicit 'not covered by our sources' answer, not to invent one.

citizenship.description: Citizenship mix of the buying household.

SC/SPR.display: Singapore Citizen with Singapore Permanent Resident

SPR/SPR.source_wording: SPR household (i.e., an SPR household with no SC applicant)

SC/NR.display: Singapore Citizen with non-resident spouse/ family

foreigner_only.display: Foreigner(s) without an SC or SPR in the household

first_timer.description: Whether the household is buying with first-timer status (as defined by HDB).

3gen.note: Not confirmed as a separate flat_type in the resale dataset.

2-room-flexi.note: Not confirmed as a separate flat_type in the resale dataset.

town.description: HDB town. Canonical value = db_form (uppercase, as in the resale dataset).
